UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated OpenCodeZex user profile metadata for ownership and account display.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Primary email address associated with the signed-in Google account.

displayName.description: User display name shown in account settings.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: User-scoped application configuration including theme preference, active server, selected agent/model, and setup wizard state.

activeProfileId.description: ID of the currently active server profile.

selectedProviderId.description: ID of the active AI provider.

selectedModelId.description: ID of the active AI model.

setupCompleted.description: Whether initial setup onboarding has been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

ServerProfileConfig.title: ServerProfileConfig
ServerProfileConfig.description: User-scoped server connection profile (local Android runtime, Termux, LAN, or remote OpenCode server).

name.description: Human-readable name of the server profile.

baseUrl.description: Normalized server URL or local://android URI.

password.description: Optional server authentication password or token.

mode.description: Runtime mode indicating built-in Android runtime or remote server.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

ProviderAccountConfig.title: ProviderAccountConfig
ProviderAccountConfig.description: User-scoped AI provider configuration including custom endpoint URL, API key, format, default model, and cached models.

name.description: Display name of the AI provider.

baseUrl.description: Base endpoint URL for the provider API.

apiKey.description: User-supplied API key stored privately under their user subtree.

defaultModelId.description: Default model ID selected for this provider.

apiFormat.description: Protocol format expected by the provider endpoint.

envVarName.description: Environment variable name used when syncing to OpenCode servers.

customFlag.description: True if this provider was added manually by the user.

cachedModels.description: Cached model IDs available for this provider.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the provider account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the provider account was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document owned by the signed-in user.

/users/{userId}/app_settings/{settingId}.description: User-scoped OpenCodeZex app settings and active selections.

/users/{userId}/provider_accounts/{accou.description: User-scoped AI provider endpoints, API keys, and cached models.
